text: Got it, moving in the open!
I have the squad! On me!
I'm in command! Hold it together!
Did you see what it did to him?
Oh God, oh God, oh God!
I give up! I give up!
All units, Command has a fix. Sending it now.
Thermal has a rough position. Move.
They're all dead! All of them!
Oh God, there's so much blood.
I don't want to die here.
Hold it there! Don't let it up!
Rounds on that corner, keep them on it!
Grenade on that position, move it!
All of you, on it, now!
It's heading for the door! Beat it there!
On the door. Not a sound.
Set up here. Wait for it.
Weapons on the frame. Nobody fires till I say.
Quiet. Let it come to us.
Nothing left! Anyone got a mag?
It shot me! It shot me!
Hold fire! It's got one of ours!
Don't hit him! Get round the side!
He's gone anyway. Take the shot.
Shoot through him. That's an order.
Eyes on the subject. He is moving.
No eyes on the hostile. Report.
He broke contact. Watch the corners.
Noise on our flank. Stay sharp.
Casualty. Mark the spot, keep moving.
We lost the lead. Hold your positions.
I have the squad. Form on me.
I am lead now. Same orders.
Taking his side. Keep him looking at you.
Pull back to the next line.
Be advised, the tango is not normal.
Rounds are hitting him. He does not care.
Command, the subject is still standing.
Whatever he is, he was not in the briefing.
Breaking off. I am breaking off.
Request permission to leave. Granted. Leaving.
All units, Command has a fix on the tango.
Thermal has the subject. Sending a grid.
Command: thermal fix. Grid to follow.
Command to all: the subject is on thermal. Close in.
Fix confirmed. Move the net in.
Lost contact with a whole squad.
A squad is not answering. Assume lost.
Hit in the arm. Carrying on.
I am done. Take my mags.
You won. Make the shot clean.
I am out of the fight. You can see that.
Leave me. I am no threat.
Medic! Man down at my position!
Rounds on that corner. Keep them coming.
He is dug in. Frag the position.
He is running. Cut him off.
Hostile heading for the door. Beat him there.
Weapons on the frame. Hold fire.
Tango is hit. Stay on him.
Subject is slowing. Do not let up.
He shot a prisoner. Nobody surrenders.
He does not take prisoners. Fight on.
Hold fire. He has one of ours.
Check fire. Friendly in the line.
Do not hit our man. Go round.
Shoot through. I will sign for him.
Take the shot. His family gets the pension.
He came round the back. Turn.
Eyes on him. On it. Christ.
There he is. There it is. Bloody hell.
Where the hell did he... where did it go?
Lost him. Lost it. It was right there.
Did you hear that? Tell me you heard that.
Reloading! Keep him... keep it off me!
He should be down. Why isn't it down?
Christ. Did you see that? Did you see it?
Keep him... keep it down! Covering!
It's hurt! He's hurt, stay on it!
That thing's gone. Where's it gone?
I lost it. I fucking lost it.
What the fuck is that thing?
Bullets just bounce off the fucking thing!
That's a monster. That's an actual monster.
Get that thing away from me!
I'm not dying to that monster!
I'm out and it's still coming!
Shoot it! Shoot the fucking thing!
Back! Get back from that thing!
It's behind us! How is it behind us?
It got {dead}. It just... it got {dead}.
They got {dead}! They got the sergeant!
{dead} is down. I need a medic on {dead}, now.
{dead} is down. That was the lead.
{dead}! I had him, I had him right here!
{dead} is down. I was right next to him.
That was {dead}. That was my man.
Eyes on the target, dammit, he is fast!
Lost the target. Hell. Watch your sectors!
Where did he go? Somebody give me eyes!
Tango is gone. Dammit, he was right there.
Movement! Somebody tell me that was us.
Heard him. Close. Watch your corners!
Hit! Hell, I am still up!
Took one. Bloody target got me.
He is fast. Watch your sector!
Target is still up after that? Hell.
That hostile is chewing through us.
Covering! Get that gun back up!
Flanking! Keep the hostile looking at you!
Fall back! Hell, fall back now!
Pull back, the target has us!
Behind us! Dammit, he is on our six!
Stitch him up! Do not let him up!
The freak is here! Shoot it!
It's that piece of shit again!
What is that freak? What is it?
That piece of shit won't go down!
Where's the freak gone? Where is it?
Quiet. Please, just let him walk past.
Command has him. Fat lot of good.
They found him. Good for them.
Go round him! Somebody go round him!
Get him out of there! Throw something!
Don't shoot, he's got one of ours! Fuck!
Where is he? Where the fuck is he?
Keep shooting! Don't let him up!
He shot him! He shot him on his knees!
Don't give up! He kills you anyway!
He's hurt! He can bleed! Shoot him!
Got him! Fuck, I got him!
What is he? What the fuck is he?
He just keeps coming. Fuck. Fuck.
Frag his cover. Make him move.
He is behind hard cover. Put one in there.
It hit my plate! I'm okay, I'm okay!
Plate stopped it! Oh, thank god.
Plate held. Plate held. Please hold.
He hit my plate! I'm still alive!
It cracked my armour! It cracked it!
My armour's gone! He'll kill me!
Penetrator rounds. Stay in hard cover.
It went right through! Right through!
Armour does nothing! It goes straight through!
What is it shooting? It went through!
Straight through! Fuck, straight through me!
Arterial bleed. I need a tourniquet.
I'm bleeding out! Hell, there's a lot!
I'm bleeding out! Oh god, it's everywhere!
It won't stop! The blood won't stop!
So much blood. Fuck. So much.
Stop the bleeding! Somebody stop this!
Took one in the stomach. Stay calm.
My stomach. Oh no. Oh no.
My arm. My arm is gone.
Lost the arm. Lost the arm.
Where's my arm?! Somebody find my arm!
Lost the leg. Need a pull.
My leg. That was my leg.
Where's my leg? Where's my leg?!
I can't stand! My leg's gone!
Oh no. Oh no no no.
I can't move! I can't move!
Somebody get me out of here!
{buddy}, I don't want to go. Please.
We're taking casualties! We're getting killed!
Another one down! Hold on, all of you!
Did you see that? It just took him apart!
Oh fuck, oh fuck, he's gone!
He's above us, on the roof!
Watch the roofs, he's up top!
It's up top! On the roof!
Oh fuck, it's on our six!
It's behind us! How is it behind us?
He's too fast! Watch your sectors!
Too fast to track. Watch the rooftops!
It's too fast! I can't track it!
Don't let him heal! Find him!
I hit it! I hit it!
It bleeds! Did you see? It bleeds!
I got him! Fuck, I got him!
Keep your head down, little man!
Push! Push before I think about it!
Close in! Fuck it, close in!
Rocket out! Get away from behind me!
The gun's gone! What do we do?
It killed the gunner! It killed him!
No gun! We've got no gun!
No gun! We've got no gun!
He can't see! Go! Fuck, go!
{squad} to anyone! Contact {cardinal}! It's on us!
{squad}'s not answering. I think they're gone.
This is {squad}. Our radio man is down. We need help!
{squad} here. I have the radio. Need support!
This is {squad}! Anyone! We need help!
This is {squad}, {dead}'s dead, we need help!
{squad} here. {dead} is down. I have the radio.
I'm not going down without a fight.
You want me? Come and get me!
I'm not running! Fuck you, I'm not running!
Thought I was done? Pin's out!
Target's bleeding. Keep the pressure on.
Put him down and we're home for dinner.
It's bleeding! Told you it bleeds!
Not so scary now, are you?
Come on! Come on, then! I'm right here!
That all? That all you've got?
Stay sharp. He has a pattern.
Watch him. He does the same thing every time.
He's going for heads, keep your visors down!
Headshots. Keep your heads behind cover.
It only shoots heads! Keep your head down!
Heads down! It goes for heads!
Watch out for him! Fuck, watch out!
He likes the high ground, watch the roofs!
He fights from up top. Eyes on the roofs.
It's always up high! Watch the roofs!
Look up! It comes from up there!
Watch out for him! Fuck, watch out!
Explosives. Nobody bunches up. Spread out.
It blows us up when we bunch! Spread out!
Spread out! Spread out, it's got explosives!
Watch out for him! Fuck, watch out!
He wants to get close. Keep your distance.
Blade work. Nobody lets him close. Back up.
It cuts! Don't let it close! Back up!
Keep away from it! It wants you close!
Watch out for him! Fuck, watch out!
He keeps coming from behind, watch our six!
He flanks every time. Someone watch the rear.
It's always behind us! Watch the back!
Watch our backs! It keeps getting behind!
Watch out for him! Fuck, watch out!
There it is again! It came back!
I've seen what this one does. Stay sharp.
Same one as before. Don't let him close.
I've seen what it does! Don't let it close!
That's the one! That's the one that did it!
I saw what he did! I saw him do that!
Watch him. Watch what he does.
